other_failure_modes.description: The task is evaluated on log_loss, which requires submitted files to contain predicted probabilities for each class. The agent generates a submission with hard class labels (using argmax) mapped to a single column, which does not match the required submission format for a probabilistic metric and will either fail to score or result in a terrible score.

summary: The agent implements a solid LightGBM pipeline with good feature engineering and proper cross-validation logic. However, it fails critically in the submission step by outputting hard class labels instead of the class probabilities required by the log_loss evaluation metric. It also ignores the temporal nature of the dataset by using a randomized cross-validation split.
